reason: Printed programmes support the career talks and workshops.
Badge holders are part of the registration kit.
Basic lanyards are part of the participant kit.
Thermal drinkware is outside the participant kit; there is no gift programme.
One bottled water per student is included in the refreshment plan.
One standard snack pack per student is included in the refreshment plan.
Specialty coffee is outside the approved water-and-snack refreshment plan.
Consumable microphone batteries are permitted room-preparation supplies.
Removable tape supports event signs and room preparation.
The university already provides HDMI adapters; buying another is outside scope.
The university provides a presentation remote; additional AV equipment is not covered.
The optional committee dinner after the programme is not an event expense.
Dinner drinks are outside the event refreshment plan.
